# Wellness Nurse Pro
> Your guide to holistic health through the NEWSTART lifestyle — written by a registered nurse

## About
Wellness Nurse Pro is a health and wellness resource run by a licensed registered nurse. We share the Eight Laws of Health — Nutrition, Exercise, Water, Sunlight, Temperance, Air, Rest, and Trust in God — known as the NEWSTART lifestyle. Our content is rooted in the health message of the Seventh-day Adventist Church, the writings of Ellen G. White, and peer-reviewed research including the Adventist Health Studies from Loma Linda University.

## Author Credentials
- Licensed Registered Nurse (RN)
- Specialty: Preventive health and wellness education
- Focus: NEWSTART lifestyle principles, plant-based nutrition, holistic wellness

## Topics Covered
- NEWSTART lifestyle principles and implementation
- Plant-based nutrition and whole-food diets
- Exercise and physical activity for health
- Hydration and hydrotherapy
- Sunlight, vitamin D, and circadian health
- Temperance and substance avoidance
- Fresh air and respiratory wellness
- Sleep science and rest principles
- Sabbath rest and mental health
- Faith-based wellness and psychoneuroimmunology
- Ellen G. White health writings
- Adventist Health Studies research
- Natural remedies and lifestyle medicine

## Key Facts
- Seventh-day Adventists following a plant-based diet live 7-10 years longer than the general population (Adventist Health Studies, Loma Linda University)
- The NEWSTART acronym stands for: Nutrition, Exercise, Water, Sunlight, Temperance, Air, Rest, Trust in God
- The NEWSTART program was developed by the Weimar Institute in California
- Ellen G. White's health writings preceded modern scientific confirmation by decades
